title: Copilot Studio: app- and intent-first agent creation experience
summary: Hold: the data-policy PowerShell command creates a policy but does not configure the connector or endpoint restrictions the row promises. The credit-allocation API is documented, despite the automatic pre-check, but both admin paths stop before their settings. The description of a single unified screen is unsupported, and the licensing field omits published product-level access requirements.

claims.quote: select Security, and then select Data and privacy. ... Select Data policy. The Data policies list appears. ... select the data policy and select Edit Policy. ... The Assign connectors page appears.
claims.fix: Extend the existing-policy route to 'Security > Data and privacy > Data policy > policy > Edit Policy > Add an environment > Assign connectors > connector > Block'. State in the row note that endpoint restrictions use 'Configure connector > Connector endpoints' instead of Block.

claims.claim: New-DlpPolicy -DisplayName <name> -EnvironmentType <type> configures which tool connectors and knowledge-source endpoints makers can use.
claims.quote: The New-DlpPolicy cmdlet creates a new DLP policy for the logged in admin's tenant. ... -DisplayName ... Creates the policy with the input display name. ... -EnvironmentType ... The type of the environment: trial, production, sandbox, default.
claims.fix: Remove the data-policy control row (controls[0] and its rendered table row), retaining the documented data-policy guidance in prose. The printed invocation creates a policy but specifies neither connector restrictions nor endpoint rules; do not present it as the operation that configures them or claim that policy automation is undocumented.

claims.claim: Credit allocation and tenant-capacity draw are reached through Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: select Licensing. ... Under Products, select Copilot Studio, and then select Manage Copilot Credits. ... Select the environment ... Under Allocate capacity ... Under Capacity overages, select or clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant
claims.fix: Extend the draw-setting path to 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant'. In the note, state that the same environment pane's Allocate capacity field sets the credit allocation.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes environment credit allocations and tenant-pool draw settings.
claims.quote: $apiBaseUrl = "https://api.powerplatform.com" ... $apiVersion = "2024-10-01" ... Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put ... -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"
claims.fix: Keep the call. Add to the row note: 'The request body identifies scope.environmentId and the MCSMessages entitlement; allocatedEntitlements[].allocation.quantity sets the allocation, and allocatedEntitlements[].enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool and enabled sets tenant-capacity draw.'
